rulePage.reportsNote: These {details} fields help to read and reproduce a finding. Apart from {reasonCode}, they are not a stable contract: a field may be renamed or dropped in a minor release, so don’t build on them. See {schema}.
rulePage.marginBody.min: This rule measures {measure} {unit}, and the value must reach the threshold. Each result’s {margin} names the element that came closest to the threshold while still meeting it, so a pass that a small change would flip shows before it flips. Unlike the fields a finding reports, it is a stable contract. See {schema}.
rulePage.marginBody.max: This rule measures {measure} {unit}, and the value must stay under the threshold. Each result’s {margin} names the element that came closest to the threshold while still meeting it, so a pass that a small change would flip shows before it flips. Unlike the fields a finding reports, it is a stable contract. See {schema}.
rulePage.deprecatedBody: The id stays in the catalog and keeps running, but its result is fixed rather than decided per page — see {policy} for what that means for a stored baseline or a {runOnly} list that still names it.

usageBinding.seeExample: Also see {link} in the package's own repo.
usageBinding.targets: {withWcag} selects by conformance target: the rules for WCAG 2.2's Level A and AA criteria, by the level each criterion has in that version. {withBestPractices} adds the rules that test no WCAG criterion, such as {region}; on its own it runs only those.
usageBinding.packs: {withPacks} registers a {packLink} in the page before the scan, and {options} chooses its profile. A pack that doesn't run is reported as a {gap} scan gap, so a test that asserts on {getScanGaps} fails rather than passing without it.
